equal_cpu_tolerance: Fixed before the run: measured baseline CPU within 10% of the model's training, inference and search CPU.
outcome: NO_GAIN: over 900 goals the model solved 3, all concepts at equal total CPU 6, all concepts on equal budgets 5, and the model on another goal's examples 3. It did not beat all concepts, and did not beat another goal's examples, so this gives no evidence that it reads the specification.
reproduction: See README.md for the full run.
negative_controls: a changed library refused before training
second evaluator wrong coverage caught by a call count of 65,536
limitations: Solve counts are very small, 0 to 5 of 300, so this cannot rule out a modest effect; an easier exam might measure one.

Each accepted dream's function is on the training side, but some labelled component concepts are sealed-side functions: 6 or so per seed, per the previous review's audit. None is an exact exam function. This is not exam leakage, but training is not free of sealed-side components.
Dreams are combinations of concepts and may not resemble the sealed family, so this tests one training design, not neural guidance in general.
Top-12 and the dream design were not tuned.
Library snapshots were taken during an earlier LA-015 run, and LA-015 has not passed review.
CPU was measured under heavy shared load, about 2x core count, and differs between attempts; seed 29's baseline sits 9.7% under its target, near the tolerance.
The earlier equal-CPU total of 7 used an unmeasured rate estimate and is superseded by the measured 6.
